summary: Chain::remaining used unchecked addition, allowing lengths exceeding usize::MAX to wrap when overflow checks were disabled. The fix uses checked_add(...).unwrap() to guarantee a panic on overflow; it also applies this correction to remaining_mut. The candidate's saturation description is inaccurate. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, and existing chain tests and documentation examples use small buffers without exercising overflow. No detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit.
